panels.title: Current AIF Mode
panels.description: Runtime mode at the selected range end. Observe provides hypothetical cache savings only; guards may still enforce policy. Multiple active modes may be shown.

panels.title: Running AIF Version
panels.description: Build version reported by aif_runtime_info; multiple versions may appear during a rolling deployment.

panels.title: Threshold Pass Share
panels.description: Threshold passes / (passes + failures); candidate-level diagnostic, not a request-level cache hit rate. No fixed healthy threshold.

panels.title: Production Semantic Net Savings
panels.description: Actual semantic-cache net savings only; evaluation savings are displayed in the Evaluation dashboard.

panels.title: Production Gross vs Net Semantic Savings
panels.description: Actual cache savings only; absent series in Observe are expected.

panels.title: Production Exact vs Semantic Savings
panels.description: Actual cache savings only; absent series in Observe are expected.

panels.title: Production Cache Outcomes and Threshold Decisions
panels.description: Production cache outcomes and semantic candidate threshold decisions (including evaluation activity). These are distinct populations.

panels.title: Production Semantic Net Savings by Model
panels.description: Actual cache savings only; absent series in Observe are expected.

panels.title: Production Potentially Low-Value Semantic Models
panels.description: Actual cache savings only; absent series in Observe are expected.

panels.title: Usage Guard Policy Stops by Category
Streaming Outcomes
panels.description: All streaming strategies. Upstream stream failures can also increment request-level errors; series are not mutually exclusive.

panels.title: Streaming Latency
panels.description: Shared histograms aggregate delivery paths. Client TTFB is measured by AIF, not by a remote client; it is not necessarily first content-token latency. No path labels are available on these histograms.

panels.title: Streaming Upstream Intake
panels.description: Upstream byte chunks are transport chunks, not tokens or necessarily complete SSE events.

panels.title: Streaming Payload Sizes
panels.description: Upstream response sizes cover completed upstream streams. Client replay buffer measurements describe buffered SSE replay, not progressive stream payload size or process memory.

panels.title: Streaming Execution Paths / second
panels.description: Execution path selections, not completed responses or client delivery acknowledgements. Observe-mode shadow hits do not serve cached content. Unseen paths may have no series until first selected.

panels.title: Upstream Streaming Bytes / second
panels.description: Transport bytes consumed by AIF across controlled and progressive upstream streams.

title: AI Cost Firewall Diagnostics
description: Diagnostics dashboard for AI Cost Firewall including readiness, semantic lookup counts, threshold decisions, embedding overhead, cache-type savings, provider latency/errors, dependency failures, evidence delivery health, guard orchestration outcomes and latency, Usage Guard policy stops, operational health, and streaming outcomes, provider/client latency, upstream intake, timeout failures, and payload sizes. Intentional Security/Usage policy decisions remain control outcomes rather than operational errors. Detailed Privacy Guard, Security Guard, and Usage Guard findings remain in their product-specific dashboards.
